scientific_integrity: The network interpretation and terminal-removable histogram are distinguished from prior scalar enumeration; no independent assessment or numerical precision claim is made.
scientific_limitations: Fixed unique dyad, minimum arcs, simple directed network, and universal sure-thing consensus only; refined terminal-agent histogram. Pre-existing unrefined counts acknowledged as OEIS A103353. Finite experiments are not an infinite proof.
title: Exact terminal-agent profile of sparsest single-reciprocal consensus networks
